Package aed.CSVAdministration

Class CSV

java.lang.Object
aed.CSVAdministration.CSV
public class CSV extends Object
CSV is the class that is in charge of opening a file and reading its information, saving a file and 'saving as' a file. In summary, this class has several functions that represent options number 1, 8 and 9 from the menu shown to the user.

  • Method Details

    • openPopulationFromFile

      public static Population openPopulationFromFile(String filePath)
      Function that opens a file using the path stored in the variable current file path and prints a message showing that the operation was successful or throws an error if it was not.
      Parameters:
      filePath - stores the file path the user introduced in the main
      Returns:
      the read population which is created and loaded with the mice if there were any in the CSV file. If not, the function returns null

    • savePopulation

      public static void savePopulation(Population populationCreated, String filePath, boolean openedFile, boolean savedAs) throws CSVExceptions
      Function that saves a population only if it has already been saved as in the past. First, it checks if the population was already saved as in the past and, if it wasn't it calls the function 'save as'. If it was, it writes the data to save in the file, just as it is done in the 'save as' method.
      Parameters:
      populationCreated - stores the population the user has created (if any) or null otherwise
      filePath - stores the path where the file has already been saved as, or null if it hasn't been 'saved as' yet
      Throws:
      CSVExceptions - if the population was not saved as or if the user has not opened a file.
      InputExceptions - if the user has not created a population.

    • savePopulationAs

      public static void savePopulationAs(Population populationCreated, String newFilePath, boolean fileOpened, boolean savedAs) throws InputExceptions, CSVExceptions
      Function that saves the created population in a text file.
      Parameters:
      populationCreated - stores the population the user wants to 'save as' if he/she has created one or null otherwise
      newFilePath - path introduced by the user
      Throws:
      InputExceptions - if the user has not created a population yet.
      CSVExceptions - if the user has not opened a file.
